name: Apollo Portal Console
description: Manage Apollo 2.x configuration with independently authored pages and password login. Known visual parity gaps remain.
releaseNotes: 0.2.0 candidate: guarded MCP read previews, ordinary changes and explicitly confirmed administration across existing Apollo APIs. Managed secrets and raw binary export bytes are withheld from MCP; UI behavior is unchanged. Matching updated DBX and standalone MCP are required. No access is granted by upgrading. Prior visual/native acceptance gaps remain; author packages are unsigned inputs and publication/signing are separate gates.
